aab3e30dad41: Write on the board: «To jest jezioro. Jezioro jest głębokie.» Ask how to say it in one sentence. Collect the answers, don't correct.
7752c406eeac: As in English: «the lake which is very deep». Polish który = English «which / who / that» in a relative clause.
f792c6416c14: The main rule of the lesson. Gender — from the noun before the comma, case — from the verb after it.
31d019bc1dce: Endings as in the adjective «nowy, nowa, nowe, nowi». Show the parallel: nowi turyści — turyści, którzy.
609996e3c9dc: Just like adjectives: widzę nowy kanał, but znam nowego przewodnika. The dopełniacz (genitive) after a negation: nie znam.
0dea133e8b2d: «Której» is one form for three feminine cases, like «nowej». Learners pick this up quickly.
4c2a3d311c61: Again a parallel with adjectives. Ask students to decline «nowi turyści» and put «którzy» next to it.
6245c1ab62bd: «Którzy» only when there is at least one man in the group. Kobiety → które, like «nowe malarki».
75ee6f462f51: the place I was talking about
139de9e8bc29: the village we are going to
23193d928f64: Unlike English («the film I talked about»), the preposition comes before the pronoun: «o którym», «do którego». Never put the preposition at the end of the sentence.
b046eef7de7a: Like English: «the town where I live» = «the town in which I live». Dokąd — where to, skąd — where from.
07a38c738a23: Whoever has been to Wieliczka knows.
5b6a1a45fe0f: English «everything that» → wszystko, co. The typical mistake is «wszystko, które».
ac42ce8affe5: I don't know a forest like the one near Gryfino.
4a0f21228e0c: It's the most beautiful place I know.
4c7b1f60778c: A subtle difference. At B1 it is enough: after the superlative — jaki; for a specific thing — który.
ffbe605f16b6: This is a canal that has inclined planes.
6ccc0fcbdd4f: The canal, which has inclined planes, is unique.
b2174c4881d6: I'll show you the place where I went diving.
cfdf58a991ae: The subordinate clause is set off by commas on both sides. Students often forget the second comma.
282a02649532: a painter whose house is a museum
0e29803265e5: English «whose» in a subordinate clause → którego / której / których. «Czyj» is only for questions: Czyj to dom?
7213f592d9d6: The first three are cases and prepositions. Ask students to correct the sentences from the warm-up.
0b88dcc1ba52: The second group of three are words with no direct English equivalent. Repeat all six out loud.
